g.title: AgentOverview
g.text: What the agent does: one question, one experiment at a time
Blue = language model decides · Amber = ordinary code checks · Green = real execution

g.title: cluster_loop
g.text: One investigation — this cycle repeats while the budget lasts

g.title: design
g.text: Fresh model window reads the catalog,

g.title: validate
g.text: and whether the cluster can actually fit it

g.title: record
g.text: Every reply, tool call and verdict, kept for audit

g.title: execute
g.text: Loads the data, runs the benchmark,
writes raw evidence and a report

g.title: assess
g.text: spread across repetitions, where it failed

g.title: interpret
g.text: Fresh model window reads that one report
and records a verdict with evidence paths

g.title: gate
g.text: Required files opened? Verdict cites this result?

g.title: author
g.text: Fresh model window writes the next

g.title: answer
g.text: Answer, with the evidence it rests on

g.title: note
g.text: The model proposes and concludes; code controls execution and evidence access.
Computed claims and any model disputes are recorded together.

g.title: firewall
g.text: Every tool call is checked against the list
that phase was offered; anything else is refused

g.title: endpoint
g.text: Self-hosted in the cluster, or a hosted broker;
switched off while a benchmark runs
